from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its own title and the list of papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cited_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of all works referenced in this paper's bibliography")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the bibliography anchoring the citations")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
